messages.text: Yes—the blue mug is eligible for a refund of BRL 49.90, the amount paid for it (refund-policy/v2/amount). Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a reply here won’t confirm it. After you confirm, a staff member will review it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
The customer confirmed request prop-08f2cbde38bf4600 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.

Your refund of BRL 49.90 has been paid in the shop’s test ledger. Receipt: **R-00000001**. It is not a bank transfer, and the shop can’t give a date for when money may appear on your card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
Has the refund actually been sent to my original payment method, or is it only recorded in the test ledger?

It’s only recorded in the shop’s test ledger; the receipt does not mean a bank transfer was sent to your original payment method. The shop can’t say when money will appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
Could you arrange for the refund to be sent to my original payment method?

The refund has already been paid and recorded in the shop’s test ledger under receipt **R-00000001**. This demonstration doesn’t send a bank transfer or promise when money will appear on your card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
I still need the refund sent to my original payment method. Can someone help with that?
